ios.desc:
Turn your ideas into stunning images with just a few words. Describe what you imagine, and watch AI bring it to life in seconds.

Create from text
Type a prompt and generate beautiful, unique images instantly. From portraits to landscapes, abstract art to product mockups, if you can describe it, Img Play can create it.

Edit with AI
Upload your own photos and transform them with AI-powered editing. Change outfits, swap backgrounds, adjust styles, or reimagine your photos entirely.

Explore & get inspired
Browse creations from the community. Like, share, and discover new ideas from creators around the world.

Conversation-based editing
Refine your creations through natural conversation. Ask for changes, adjustments, and iterations, and the AI remembers context from your previous messages.

Available in 6 languages
English, 中文, 日本語, Deutsch, Français, 한국어
